LanguageData.MM_SelfDestructDesc: Confirm to eject the pilot and destroy the warframe. Ejection range: 50 cells. Blast radius: 8 cells; damage: 80; armor penetration: 80%.
LanguageData.MM_SelfDestructPilot: After confirming, select a visible, valid landing cell within 50 cells. The pilot ejects with their equipment and personal inventory, then the warframe explodes immediately. Choose a landing point outside the red blast ring; nearby landings risk injury or death. Right-click or press Esc while targeting to cancel without detonating.
LanguageData.MM_SelfDestructEmpty: There is no pilot. Confirmation detonates immediately, without selecting a landing point.
LanguageData.MM_SelfDestructUnavailable: Self-destruction is unavailable in the current state.
